$comment: CrossCode engine symbol map — maps minified identifiers back to readable names. Generated by build-symbol-map.js from deobf/extract vs deobf/clean (v1.4.2-3 build). modules[module][minifiedName] = { readableName: occurrenceCount } sorted by count desc. The same minified token is reused across scopes, so several readable names per token is normal; the first (highest count) is the best guess for any given occurrence.
